hero.subtitle: AI call centers, a dedicated Sovereign AI Factory, SAMA CSF programs and trade-finance ledgers for banks and financial institutions.

context.title: Where we play
context.body: Banking is one of our two strongest fits, across almost the whole portfolio. Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, Intelligent Operations and Blockchain are primary fits; IoT & Edge is a limited fit. The typical first engagement is an AI Call Center POC or a SAMA CSF assessment.

challenges.title: SAMA CSF
challenges.body: SAMA CSF applies to banks and SAMA-regulated financial institutions.

challenges.title: Dedicated AI on your own data
challenges.body: Banking and financial services are a destination for the single-tenant Sovereign AI Factory, with private Arabic-capable LLMs, RAG and AI agents.

challenges.title: Customer contact, 24x7
challenges.body: Voice and chat agents resolve queries 24x7, in Arabic and English, and hand over to a human when sentiment turns.

challenges.title: Asset inventory
challenges.body: SAMA's cyber framework requires an accurate, current inventory of technology assets.

useCases.title: AI Call Center POC
useCases.body: A live demo of all three agents, and a POC on your highest-volume call flows.

useCases.title: SAMA CSF assessment
useCases.body: A maturity assessment and remediation program.

useCases.title: Trade finance and settlement
useCases.body: Smart-contract invoices, letters of credit and multi-party settlement without manual reconciliation, aligned to the SAMA regulatory sandbox.

useCases.title: Lending agents
useCases.body: Lending is one of the eight vertical agent products live on the agentic AI platform.

vision2030.body: Our work is aligned with SAMA's framework for banks, alongside NCA and PDPL, with data and AI kept in-Kingdom.
